Mira: Quick follow-up from today's RFC review. Two items we didn't resolve: offline bundle format for Private installs, and standardized "reason codes" for precision downgrades. Wanted to capture proposals and get quick thumbs.

Sam: For the runtime hot path we absolutely cannot parse big JSON. Offline bundle should compile to a small binary blob: header + fingerprint + table of bitpaths. Runtime reads fixed offsets.

Reese: Ops viewpoint: bundle needs to be signed and include a monotonic version and rollback token. Private installs will import the bundle file and validate signature and version before applying.

Yasmin: Product note: customers want human-readable audit info too. We should include a short manifest (plaintext) alongside the binary blob that lists human-friendly labels and the fallback mappings. That manifest can be stored by the customer for audits.

Mira: Proposed bundle layout (sketch): 1) JSON manifest (small) 2) protobuf fingerprint index 3) binary compact table of bitmasks per shape 4) signature block. Runtime uses the fingerprint index and table only.

Sam: Suggest compressing the binary table with a simple RLE for repeated shapes to keep startup memory low. Also add an mmap-friendly alignment so we can zero-copy map in Dedicated.

Reese: We need an import validation step that checks for conflicting overrides (customer vs global). The import should produce an import report with conflict resolutions recorded.

Yasmin: On reason codes: we modeled a small taxonomy during the RFC but didn't land on names. Proposal: use compact reason keys that are stable and machine-friendly, plus optional human message. Examples: "latency_budget_exceeded", "quality_guardrail_violation", "capacity_fallback", "pinned_by_customer", "shadow_acceptance".

Sam: Keep the keys short; maybe snake_case is fine. Runtime will attach the reason key to traces and to the quality_token metadata. No long strings.

Mira: How should clients surface the reason? Response header? SDK field? Both? Product wants visible dropdown in Console.

Yasmin: Header + SDK field is useful: header for simple integrations, SDK for richer UI. Header name: x-precision-reason. Also include x-precision-fingerprint and optionally x-quality-token when shadowed.

Reese: For Private imports we must support stripping sensitive telemetry: bundle manifest should include a flag "allow_quality_echo" that customer can set to false to prevent shipping sample payloads back to control plane. We should respect that in the runtime and in server-side telemetry.

deploy-bot: New canary bundle published: profile-fp8-v3 bundle id bf3a1c -> canary 0.5% at 2026-04-02T05:00Z :package: 

Sam: One more runtime note: provide a minimal C header for runtimes in C++/Rust that defines the fingerprint struct (u64 id, u32 bitmask_ptr, u32 fallback_id). Keep alignment predictable. I'll draft it.

Mira: Action items: Mira -> merge bundle spec draft. Sam -> push mmap-friendly example + C header. Reese -> write import validation checklist and conflict report schema. Yasmin -> finalize reason code list and header names. We'll review in tomorrow sync.

Yasmin: Quick comment: include an "explainability_url" field in manifest to link to Console text for customers on what the codes mean. Helps CS.

Mira: Nice. Thanks team. I'll post the PR and tag everyone.
